articles.title: Phillies’ quest to clinch a playoff spot stalls again with 5-1 loss to the Brewers
articles.description: The Phillies’ magic number remains two with a weekend series against the AL-leading Rays left to lock up a spot in the postseason.

articles.title: Phillies’ Luis Arraez leaves game vs. Brewers with a sprained left ankle
articles.description: Arraez tried to dodge a tag at first base and he appeared to twist his ankle and fell to the ground in pain. As the Phillies ’ push for a playoff berth continues, their offense was dealt a blow when ...

articles.title: Phillies will need Game 162 to get into the playoffs, or complete their collapse after another loss to Rays
articles.description: With the Phillies’ 12-1 loss to the Rays, their drawn-out collapse has become a five-alarm fire of humiliation. They will need Sunday to decide their fate.

articles.title: Aaron Nola starts on two days’ rest vs. Rays as Phillies look to clinch postseason berth
articles.description: Nola, who was the winning pitcher in the Phillies' 2022 wild-card clincher, may just go through the Rays' lineup once.

articles.title: The free-falling Phillies aren’t done yet: ‘We have hope.’ And it starts with Zack Wheeler on Sunday.
articles.description: Win and they’re in the playoffs, and they can even lose and get in (with an Arizona loss). "You’ve got to do what you’ve got to do if that’s what it takes for us to get in," said Don Mattingly.

articles.title: The Phillies are on the verge of the worst collapse in the city’s history. That says something.
articles.description: The goal now is to avoid infamy. It is to preserve legacy. It is to summon the last shred of political capital they earned in 2022 and escape from Game 162 with a reason to believe.

articles.title: Bill Giles, the former Phillies owner who helped create the Phillie Phanatic, has died at 92
articles.description: Once described as “Philadelphia’s resident combination of P.T. Barnum and Walt Disney,” Mr. Giles got creative trying to attract fans. The biggest draw was the mascot he green lit in 1978.

articles.title: Phillies won’t play on NBC Sports Philadelphia the next few nights amid playoff push

articles.title: Phillies’ chances of clinching a wild card put on hold with 4-1 loss to the Brewers
articles.description: The Phillies finished 0-for-12 with runners in scoring position and Aaron Nola allowed four runs across six innings.
